name: dev-harness
description: Dev Harness - 自驱动开发流水线 | 命令: /dev (全流程) /fix (快速修复) /test (运行测试) /audit (代码审计) /review (代码审查) /ask (对话问答) | 特性: 三层 Skill 解析 + 多模式(pipeline/single/conversation) + Web HUD 实时面板 + 12 专用 Agent

interface.shortDescription: Self-driving dev pipeline with gates and auto-resume
interface.longDescription: Runs a full research-plan-implement-audit-test-review pipeline automatically, with build/test gates at every phase and a Stop hook that resumes the run until the pipeline is actually done. Use Dev Harness for large or multi-step features that benefit from disciplined, unattended execution.
defaultPrompt: Run the full dev pipeline on this feature
Fix the current bug and verify the fix
Run a multi-agent code review on this branch
